mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 consult_key FROM erp_consult WHERE phone = #{phone} AND center_code = #{centerCode} AND consult_key IS NOT NULL AND consult_key != '' ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_consult ( student_name, consult_date, school, grade_key, phone, inflow_route_key, progress_key, content, created_at, center_code, user_code, consult_key, inquiry_hoho, inquiry_han, inquiry_book, inquiry_doc ) VALUES ( #{studentName}, #{consultDate}, #{school}, #{gradeKey}, #{phone}, #{inflowRouteKey}, #{progressKey}, #{content}, SYSDATETIME(), #{centerCode}, #{userCode}, #{consultKey}, #{inquiryHoho}, #{inquiryHan}, #{inquiryBook}, #{inquiryDoc} )
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_consult SET student_name = #{studentName}, consult_date = #{consultDate}, school = #{school}, grade_key = #{gradeKey}, phone = #{phone}, inflow_route_key = #{inflowRouteKey}, content = #{content}, consult_type = #{consultType}, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE id = #{consultId};
